message: 伝わらない

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's morning, wake up!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Uuh...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on Synn, how long are you gonna sleep.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gasp, Macaron!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wrong person!」

name: Synn
message: 「Abushi!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jeez, you hopeless horn-dog...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow-ow... Aah, Nanaka, morning...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, morning. Rare to see you still sleeping in. You look exhausted too...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... Ah, where's Macaron!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mako-chan? Isn't she at her morning part-time job?」

name: Synn
message: 「Right, I need to hurry and find Macaron--ah, ow-ow-ow...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What, sore muscles? How pathetic.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Clutching your lower back like that, you look like an old man. Did you do some intense exercise or... gasp!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Y-You, d-don't tell me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, last night was pretty rough in a lot of ways...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Last night!? You mean at night!?」

name: Synn
message: 「It was my first time feeling anything like that...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Awawawa...」

name: Synn
message: 「Something hot welled up from deep inside. Even now, just remembering it gives me chills...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugyaaah! You pervert!」

name: Synn
message: 「Debeah!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Grief... Making a racket this early in the morning.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey, P-man! Yesterday, Synn and Mako-chan, um, well...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ah, truth is, Synn-sama messed up a little, see.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Messed up!」

name: Paqy
message: 「And ended up making the little runt mad.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I see... Well, it was his first time, so it can't be helped...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, is that how it usually goes...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No-no-no, it's nothing, it's just something I heard about!」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Oi, what are you talkin' about?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, obviously, you know, getting frisky, or lovey-dovey smooching, or going bump-bump in the night...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you making me say--!」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy, I think your explanation just now was a bit lacking.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eek!? You don't need to go into detail!」

name: Synn
message: 「I have to tell everyone today too...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What kind of humiliation play is this!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Feigning innocence to humiliate his childhood friend--just as expected of the Demon Lord!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hahaha... The Demon Lord, huh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Somehow, when it actually comes down to it, it's hard to know how to react.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry for keeping quiet about it until now.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I mean, that couldn't really be helped.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean, I kinda get how you felt... like it was hard to bring up given your position.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, I get why Mako-chan is mad, too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even I've been by your side for a pretty long time, Synn...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So I can't help thinking you could've at least talked to me about it a little.」

name: Synn
message: 「...I'm hopeless, aren't I...」
No wonder Macaron is angry with me.
Even though I claimed I loved her and cared about her....
To think I didn't even consider trying to get her to understand me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, don't beat yourself up like that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's not like I'm blaming you for it or anything, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And I'm sure Mako-chan doesn't actually hate you either.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's just, in Mako-chan's case, she was all fired up about becoming the Demon Lord herself, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So to her, it must've felt like being told right to her face that she was a fake.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's no surprise she took it hard.」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaah... What have I done...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey Soba, what're you cornering him for?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, I'm trying to cheer him up here!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's because I was so insensitive...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, look, it's not your fault you turned out to be the Demon Lord, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, I don't want the Demon Lord's power...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you talking about!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks to that power, you were able to protect Mako-chan, right!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you saying you'd have been fine not saving Mako-chan, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true! There's no way I'd be fine with that!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's just... that power hurt Macaron, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「So I'm wondering if it's really okay for me to accept it...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, Demon Lord.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That power is already inside you.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It belongs to you, Demon Lord--including the responsibility of wielding it.」
This happened because of me.
Settling the score is my job. Makes sense, doesn't it...

name: Synn
message: 「...I wonder if Macaron will understand.」

name: Paqy
message: 「As for that, we won't know until we talk to Shorty.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Yeah, you're right.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going to go look for Macaron right now.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey now, what are you gonna do about the academy?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is the Student Council President gonna skip class again?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You seem kinda reckless right now, Synn, y'know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why don't we talk it over with everyone first?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mako-chan might actually show up for her part-time shift at Prier, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Yeah.」
Or so I hoped, anyway...
Having screamed that she didn't even want to look at my face, there was no way Macaron would conveniently show up at the academy.

name: Synn
message: 「--And so, that's the situation...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see...」

name: Helena
message: 「You did well telling us. Thank you, Synn-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「I've been deceiving everyone this whole time...」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. We're not bringing that up anymore, okay?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whether you're a Demon Lord or a Hero, Mr. President is still Mr. President through and through.」

name: Misa
message: 「Though I still can't accept that only Sakura-kun has that kind of talent!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See? Told ya nobody'd mind.」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, couldn't you have at least relied on us?」

name: Misa
message: 「Pulling something like this really disqualifies you as president.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're completely right...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, harping on what's already done won't get us anywhere.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Especially since Synn-kun finally opened up to us about his secret.」

name: Melilot
message: 「With this, it should be a bit easier to devise countermeasures against Re-Crea.」

name: Helena
message: 「My, how pragmatic of you.」

name: Melilot
message: 「We can't exactly afford to take it easy, can we?」

name: Melilot
message: 「The strongest of the Demon Generals desires Re-Crea. We must make our move early.」

name: Misa
message: 「Could this Bylous person be the one who's been pulling the strings behind the scenes all this time?」

name: Melilot
message: 「At present, it's still hard to say either way.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, judging by his personality, I find it difficult to believe he would resort to such petty tricks.」

name: Melilot
message: 「We would do well to consider the possibility that another mastermind exists.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You seem awfully well-informed about all this, Ms. Librarian.」

name: Melilot
message: 「The sheer volume of my knowledge is on a different level from yours.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. It's that classic saying: with old age--and an older woman--comes wisdom!」

name: Helena
message: 「Mfufu, you really get it, don't you, Lolotte-chan.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena, please stop fooling around.」

name: Helena
message: 「What, it's the truth, isn't it.」

name: Helena
message: 「Now, now, calm down.」

name: Helena
message: 「No matter how much we strategize, if our all-important Demon Lord is like this, it's completely hopeless, right.」

name: Synn
message: 「......Huh? What were we talking about again?」

name: Melilot
message: 「......Absent-minded would be the right word for it, I suppose.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For Synn, there's something way more on his mind than Re-Crea anyway.」

name: Ria
message: 「You mean Macaron-chan, right.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Haa...... So that's what this is about.」

name: Helena
message: 「First things first, we have to resolve Synn-chan's little dilemma.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed, it would be troublesome if the Demon Lord isn't in the right mindset.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If it were that easy, we wouldn't be having any trouble.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Great Sage Paqy......」

name: Helena
message: 「It's frustrating, but even if we butt in, there's nothing we can do about it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, if it's Synn, he'll be fine.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right. If it's the President and his little sister, they'll come to understand each other in no time!」

name: Ria
message: 「Just like during KiraFes, right.」

name: Misa
message: 「The peace of the world is at stake here, so pull yourself together.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Certainly, if he cannot even overcome a difficulty of this caliber, he may be unfit to be the Demon Lord.」

name: Helena
message: 「Come on, just cheer him on a little more honestly.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku...... What a high-maintenance Demon Lord we've got.」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone...... thank you. I'll definitely work things out with Macaron.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going to try my best to get her to accept that I'm the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「If I can just convince Macaron...」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, I'm sure...」

name: Synn
message: 「I think I'll finally be able to truly accept that I'm the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank goodness, it's Macaron's tent.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Doesn't she have anywhere else to go...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron, are you there...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron, I really want to talk to you.」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Maybe she's not in?」

name: Synn
message: 「But she wasn't at the academy or the shopping district either...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then let's take a peek inside the tent.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way, not without asking...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Sometimes you gotta use a little force.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Coming in!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gyaaaahhh!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh? Oh, Lord Great Sage!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Y-Y-Yeah! You almost gave me a bald spot right there!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I-I'm sorry, I thought you were my big brother...」

name: Synn
message: 「You'd ambush me with a slash if it were me...?」

name: Synn
message: 「...You're off from your part-time job today, huh.」

name: Macaron
message: 「...There's no point trying hard at anything anymore anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not...」

name: Macaron
message: 「...So, what did you come here for, Demon Lord.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even though I told you I didn't want to see you...」

name: Synn
message: 「I wanted to make up with you, Macaron.」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's not like we were fighting or anything.」

name: Synn
message: 「Were we never on good terms to begin with...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mghhh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Listen to me, Macaron.」

name: Synn
message: 「Back then, I just wanted to protect you.」

name: Synn
message: 「I never meant to hurt you, and I didn't care at all about the Demon Lord's power.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I know that...」

name: Synn
message: 「Can't we go back to the way things used to be...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Why do you want to do that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother, why do you feel that way?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm fine with things just the way they are now.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Since I can't become the Demon Lord anymore anyway...」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, Macaron...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll leave everything to you, Big Brother.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Re-Crea, world peace--you can just handle all of it yourself, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because I don't know anything anymore!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not like you at all, Macaron!」

name: Macaron
message: 「What do you even know about me, Big Brother!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「You don't know a single thing about how I feel!」

name: Macaron
message: 「You haven't even noticed how betrayed I feel...」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Go home.」

name: Synn
message: 「But, um...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Don't ever come back! I hate you so much, big brother!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That was a total defeat, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「You talk like it's someone else's problem...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, it's a fact that the Demon Lord's thinking was shallow, man.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just saying 'let's all get along' ain't gonna cut it anymore.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Sigh.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you're that dense, no wonder you made her mad.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why I'm asking what you mean.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wouldn't that be pointless if you don't figure it out yourself?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Haaah~...」

name: Macaron
message: 「In the end, I couldn't even properly tell him I love him, huh...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Couldn't become the Demon Lord, and couldn't confess either...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Shutting myself in and moping around just like I used to...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm so pathetic...」

name: Melphas
message: 「Do you truly intend to let things end just like this?」

name: Macaron
message: 「...You were here.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Princess, are you genuinely content leaving things as they are?」

name: Macaron
message: 「What are you trying to say.」

name: Melphas
message: 「You may take my words at face value.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Of course... I'm not okay with it.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I've done nothing but lose to both Bylous and big brother, and there are still things I want to say, and things I want to hear...」

name: Melphas
message: 「In that case...」

name: Macaron
message: 「But I can't become the Demon Lord!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I don't have any allies. I don't have any power. Like this, there's nothing I can do...」

name: Melphas
message: 「...Nothing you can do, is it?」

name: Yasubee
message: 「Eee!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Right...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I still have you with me...」

name: Melphas
message: 「...It's a bit late to ask, but are you just going to ignore me?」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's super suspicious whether you're actually on my side!」

name: Melphas
message: 「I am interested in watching you grow, Princess, as a woman, and above all, as the Demon Lord...」

name: Melphas
message: 「Is that alone not enough to earn your trust?」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Whatever, I don't care.」

name: Melphas
message: 「I see...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still... you're right.」

name: Macaron
message: 「At the very least, I know I can't just stay like this.」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I don't know what to do, I just have to think it through.」

name: Macaron
message: 「About what I should do from here on out...」
